faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) for positions located in Mangalore, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in MAHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post is Project Research Scientist -I (Non-Medical) under the project-based research field category.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist -I (Non-Medical) position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master of Physiotherapy (MPT) or a Master of Occupational Therapy (MOT) degree to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 56,000/- plus 20% HRA, making a total monthly remuneration of Rs. 67,200.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for MAHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to send your detailed CV and application via email is October 14, 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their detailed CV and required documents through email to [email protected] before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the subject line required for the email application?
faq.answer: You must mention the Job Code 'Application for Project Research Scientist -I (Non-Medical) – KMC, Mangalore' in the email subject line.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their qualifications followed by an interview for the shortlisted individuals.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the contract for this project position?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially for a period of one year and can be extended up to three years based on performance and project requirements.
